evidence.detail: rs/gui/Launcher constructs exactly one rs/gui/E, stores it as the dedicated client-surface field and sizes it from the launcher client dimension.
Launcher initializes/starts the live rs/Client and then adds that Client component directly to rs/gui/E at BorderLayout.CENTER.
The panel is then mounted into the launcher frame/container beside the launcher side panel; rs/gui/E itself owns only the client-hosting BorderLayout, black background and viewport sizing.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the launcher panel whose sole role is hosting the live game Client component.
